svg.aria-label: From sensor to screen, five stations along the data river: 1 Sense (ESP32, GPS, cameras), 2 Connect (MQTT, Wi-Fi, LAN), 3 Process (Node-RED, REST APIs, Python), 4 Store (InfluxDB, PostgreSQL, Supabase), 5 Show (Next.js, React, Leaflet).
